function prepare({event,collectionId,parentDocumentId}){if(!event||event.object_kind!=='release'||!['create','update','delete'].includes(event.action))throw Error('Invalid GitLab release event');if(event.action!=='create')return{publish:false,body:{}};if(typeof event.name!=='string'||!event.name.trim()||typeof event.url!=='string'||!/^https?:\/\/\S+$/i.test(event.url))throw Error('Invalid GitLab release');if(typeof collectionId!=='string'||!collectionId.trim()||collectionId.startsWith('YOUR_'))throw Error('Configure the Outline collection ID');if(typeof parentDocumentId!=='string'||parentDocumentId.startsWith('YOUR_'))throw Error('Configure or clear the parent document ID');const description=event.description==null?'':event.description;if(typeof description!=='string')throw Error('Invalid release description');return{publish:true,body:{collectionId,...(parentDocumentId.trim()?{parentDocumentId:parentDocumentId.trim()}:{}),publish:true,title:'Release '+event.name,text:description+'\n\n\\\n[More info]('+event.url+')'}}}

return $input.all().flatMap((x,i)=>{const p=prepare({event:x.json.body,collectionId:'YOUR_COLLECTION_ID',parentDocumentId:''});return p.publish?[{json:p,pairedItem:{item:i}}]:[]});

function confirm({body,statusCode}){if(statusCode<200||statusCode>=300||!body||body.ok===false||typeof body.data?.id!=='string'||!body.data.id)throw Error('Outline document was not confirmed; inspect before retry');return{document:body.data}}

return $input.all().map((x,i)=>({json:confirm({body:x.json.body,statusCode:x.json.statusCode}),pairedItem:{item:i}}));
